steps.en: System detects no bank details X days after the letter notification is sent
steps.id: Sistem mendeteksi bank details belum masuk X hari setelah letter notification dikirim
steps.why_en: Nothing tracks the deadline for a refund.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pelacakan tenggat untuk refund.

steps.id: Refund advice yang gagal dihidupkan kembali
steps.why_en: Only notice revival exists, not refund advice revival.
steps.why_id: Hanya revive notice yang ada, bukan revive refund advice.

steps.en: System checks and refreshes the offender's address for the refund
steps.id: Sistem mengecek dan memperbarui alamat offender untuk refund
steps.why_en: The address check only runs for notices and is not linked to refunds.
steps.why_id: Cek alamat hanya jalan untuk notice, tidak terhubung ke refund.

steps.en: System creates the 1st reminder letter requesting bank details within a set number of days
steps.id: Sistem membuat letter pengingat ke-1 yang meminta bank details dalam sekian hari
steps.why_en: No refund letter or day limit has been built.
steps.why_id: Letter refund dan batas hari belum dibuat.
